Load penetration test on RS soil at relative density approx 0.97; apparatus: LPT fixture; loading: static penetration. Recorded: load vs penetration.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 24 of the 27 points, and 2 are still under review. Student reviewers have looked at 12 of the 27 points on the scan; two reviewers confirmed 5 of them (see the provenance page). The test setup is incomplete: unit weight, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::

## Data

![load against penetration, SI units. Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-lpt-073.png){.lightbox}

Peak load 7967 N at 75.21 mm penetration, the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-lpt-073/observations.csv) (27 points: 0 plotted symbols, 23 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: load in N against penetration in m; the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-lpt-073/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 599 micrometers in penetration, 48.61 N in load (0.6 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 24 of the 27 points; 2 are still under review (hollow in the plot) and 1 was settled against the scan. [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-f2-44).
